suite: SAAMX Consolidated Build Phase 3 — Currency Expansion & FX Integrity

results.title: Pre-flight Authoritative State Hash Verification
results.scenario: Verify state.json SHA-256 matches baseline before testing
results.expected: 6c30e425ca30e0a22a5be40c7228543d1e8d716fe9a4795b3cdf136df728acca

results.title: Session Token Acquisition for FX Desk Roles
results.scenario: Acquire HMAC session tokens for exchange operator, admin, sebi, and participant teams
results.expected: HTTP 200 with valid session tokens for exchange, admin, sebi, and teams
results.actual: exchange: role=exchange, admin: role=admin, T01: role=team

results.title: Currency Directory Definition (10 Currencies)
results.scenario: Verify 10 supported currencies with code, name, symbol, precision, and flag
results.expected: 10 currencies present with JPY precision 0 and 9 others precision 2
results.actual: Found 12 currencies. JPY precision=0, USD precision=2

results.title: FX Rate Directory Structure & Bid/Ask Spreads
results.scenario: Verify 9 pairs quoted against INR with simulation label and buyRate > midRate > sellRate
results.expected: All 9 pairs present, simulation reference rate labeled, valid buy/sell spreads
results.actual: 9 pairs present=true, simulation labeled=true, spreads valid=true

results.title: Anonymous Rate Update Rejection
results.scenario: Unauthenticated actor attempts to modify FX rate
results.expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized

results.title: Participant Team Rate Modification Rejection
results.scenario: Team participant attempts to modify FX rate
results.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden

evidence.error: Forbidden: Modifying FX rates requires SEBI or Administrator authorization.

results.title: Negative / Invalid FX Rate Rejection
results.scenario: Authorized regulator submits negative midRate
results.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request with validation error
results.actual: HTTP 400: Valid currency pair and positive finite midRate are required.

evidence.error: Valid currency pair and positive finite midRate are required.

results.title: SEBI JPYINR Rate Adjustment with Decimal Precision
results.scenario: SEBI updates JPYINR midRate preserving 4 decimal places
results.expected: HTTP 200 OK with midRate=0.605, buyRate > 0.605, sellRate < 0.605

results.title: Anonymous Direct Exchange Rejection
results.scenario: Unauthenticated call to direct FX exchange
results.expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized

results.title: Participant Direct Execution Prohibition
results.scenario: Participant team attempts direct exchange without desk operator slip
results.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden with prompt to use /api/fx/request or requiring operator privileges
results.actual: HTTP 403: Forbidden: Direct currency exchange and desk queue processing require Exchange Desk Operator privileges.

evidence.error: Forbidden: Direct currency exchange and desk queue processing require Exchange Desk Operator privileges.

results.title: Exchange to Same Currency Rejection
results.scenario: Operator submits conversion of USD to USD
results.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request
results.actual: HTTP 400: Cannot exchange currency to itself.

results.title: Unsupported Currency Rejection
results.scenario: Operator submits unsupported cryptocurrency BTC
results.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request
results.actual: HTTP 400: Unsupported currency. Active currencies: INR, USD, GBP, EUR, JPY, AED, SGD, CNY, AUD, KRW

evidence.error: Unsupported currency. Active currencies: INR, USD, GBP, EUR, JPY, AED, SGD, CNY, AUD, KRW

results.title: Direct INR -> USD Exchange Execution
results.scenario: Exchange Operator sells 886,000 INR to buy USD for Team T01 at buyRate
results.expected: HTTP 200 OK, INR debited by 886,000, USD credited with 2-decimal precision
results.actual: HTTP 200: debited 886000 INR, credited 10000.35 USD @ rate 88.5969

results.title: JPY Zero-Decimal Integer Precision Enforcement
results.scenario: Convert INR to JPY and verify JPY amount is strictly integer (0 decimals)
results.expected: HTTP 200 with integer JPY credited (no floating decimals in JPY wallet)

results.title: Triangular Cross-Currency Conversions Across Currency Directory
results.scenario: Execute cross conversions: USD->EUR, AED->SGD, AUD->EUR, CNY->JPY
results.expected: HTTP 200 for all triangular conversions, accurate spreads, integer JPY

results.title: /api/fx/convert Anonymous Authentication Check
results.scenario: Unauthenticated call to /api/fx/convert
results.expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized

results.title: /api/fx/convert Team Participant Prohibition
results.scenario: Team participant attempts direct conversion via /api/fx/convert
results.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden

evidence.error: Forbidden: Direct currency exchange and desk queue processing require Exchange Desk Operator privileges.

results.title: /api/fx/convert Execution and Duplicate Ticket Guard
results.scenario: Operator converts AUD to USD and attempts duplicate ticket replay
results.expected: First call HTTP 200, duplicate ticket HTTP 400 Bad Request

duplicate.error: FX Ticket TKT-CONV-001 has already been processed.

results.title: Prevention of Overdraft Beyond Wallet Balance
results.scenario: Exchange request exceeding total wallet balance
results.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request with insufficient balance message
results.actual: HTTP 400: CAD and CHF are legacy currencies and not available for new exchange transactions.

evidence.error: CAD and CHF are legacy currencies and not available for new exchange transactions.

results.title: Unreserved Cash Balance Protection Under Two-Phase Settlement
results.scenario: Attempt exchange exceeding unreserved balance vs within unreserved balance
results.expected: Exceeding unreserved returns HTTP 400; within unreserved returns HTTP 200
results.actual: Exceeding=400 (Insufficient unreserved USD balance. Team has $100 unreserved (Total: $9,311.81, Reserved: $9,211.81), requested $500.), within=200

fail.error: Insufficient unreserved USD balance. Team has $100 unreserved (Total: $9,311.81, Reserved: $9,211.81), requested $500.

results.title: Concurrent Execution Mutex & Race Condition Guard
results.scenario: Two concurrent exchange requests fired in parallel for the same team
results.expected: Protected against race condition: either HTTP 409 Conflict or serialized clean execution

req2.error: Concurrent FX operation in progress for team T02. Please retry.

results.title: FX Queue Request Intake & Cross-Team Submission Guard
results.scenario: Team submits request for self (allowed) and for another team (forbidden)
results.expected: Self request HTTP 200 with QUEUED status; cross-team request HTTP 403 Forbidden

crossTeam.error: Forbidden: Team T01 cannot submit FX requests for team T02.

results.title: FX Queue Settlement Lifecycle & Double-Settlement Prevention
results.scenario: Transition QUEUED -> RATE_CHECK -> PROCESS -> SETTLE, verify RBAC and double-settle rejection
results.expected: RateCheck=200, Process=200, TeamSettle=403, OpSettle=200, DoubleSettle=400

doubleSettleErr.error: FX request has already been settled.

results.title: FX Transaction History Participant Privacy Isolation
results.scenario: Team T01 queries FX history vs exchange operator querying FX history
results.expected: T01 only sees T01 transactions; exchange operator sees full global ledger
results.actual: T01 saw 9 txs (all T01=true), Operator saw 10 txs (multiple teams=true)

results.title: FX Queue Participant Privacy Isolation
results.scenario: Team T01 queries active FX conversion queue
results.expected: T01 only sees queue items belonging to team T01
results.actual: T01 queue saw 1 items, all T01=true

results.title: Reconciliation Multi-Currency Cash Aggregation
results.scenario: Reconcile total market cash balance factoring in all 10 currencies
results.expected: totalCash is positive finite number aggregating all 10 wallets converted to INR

results.title: Post-Test Authoritative State Hash Verification
results.scenario: Confirm authoritative state.json remained 100% untouched throughout all tests
results.expected: 6c30e425ca30e0a22a5be40c7228543d1e8d716fe9a4795b3cdf136df728acca
